purpose: FRESH acceptance holdout. holdout_v1 is development data and must not be reused as acceptance gold. This set is UNLABELED.
label_status: UNLABELED — @adversarial-review-deepseek-agent labels; @grok-4-6 second-reviews labels BEFORE any predictions
material: public-domain U.S. statute/regulation/session-law text from OLRC, LII, eCFR, Delaware Code Online, GPO, Florida Senate. No lawsuit or private content. None of the five holdout_v1 sections (42 USC 1983, 26 USC 501, 17 USC 107, 12 CFR 1026.1, Fla. Stat. 605.0101).

input_contract.offset_unit: Python str character index (len/slicing), NOT bytes
input_contract.hash: utf8_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 file bytes; it is NOT an offset base

input_representation.decoded_unicode: the file is the exact Unicode string the parser must receive
input_representation.raw_html_entities: the file is the exact HTML fragment the parser must receive; entities such as § and   are literal characters in that string

input_contract.do_not_mix: never apply byte offsets to a str, never decode a raw_html file before labeling/scoring

taxonomy_notes_for_labeler: Session-law locators of the form N Stat. P / N STAT. P are gold citations, not false positives.
Coordinated references (e.g. sections 502 or 503) are one span if that is the surface form.
Nested prefixes are not separate gold items; longest non-overlapping spans.
Harder negatives: bare numbers, subsection letters, page chrome.

usc_18_1001_decoded.txt.source: Cornell LII HTML, text extracted (tags stripped); Unicode preserved (U+00A7, U+202F)

usc_5_552_raw.html.source: U.S. House OLRC HTML fragment stored WITHOUT entity decoding. Offsets are Python character indexes into this exact string (§ is 6 chars).

del_8_141_decoded.txt.source: Delaware Code Online Title 8 § 141 HTML, tags stripped, Unicode preserved

cfr_17_240_10b5_decoded.txt.source: eCFR HTML for 17 CFR 240.10b-5, tags stripped. Three-part CFR depth is in the heading/body.

plaw_107_204_decoded.txt.source: GPO HTML of Public Law 107-204 (Sarbanes-Oxley). Contains session-law locators (e.g. 116 STAT. 745). Tags stripped, HTML entities unescaped.

fl_607_0101_raw.html.source: Florida Senate HTML for § 607.0101 stored WITHOUT entity decoding (  em-space, — em-dash). Offsets are Python character indexes into this exact string. Different section from holdout_v1 605.0101.

scoring_rule: Do not score until grok approves labels. Then one canonical run from a clean detached worktree at a pinned parser commit, recording parser/gold/scorer hashes.
